exposure: pernicious placenta previa coexisting with placenta accreta
Cesarean section with preoperative balloon occlusion of the infrarenal abdominal aorta (study group)
prophylactic balloon occlusion of the infrarenal abdominal aorta
outcome: Neonatal outcomes (premature delivery, Apgar scores at 1 and 5 minutes, birth weight, hospitalization, mortality)
cohort: 56 patients with placenta accreta complicated with pernicious placenta previa (32 in the control group and 24 in the study group)
finding: Prophylactic balloon occlusion of the infrarenal abdominal aorta significantly reduced the rate of hysterectomy in women with pernicious placenta previa coexisting with placenta accreta without negatively impacting other maternal or neonatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was compared between the groups
